name: SilverZone International Olympiad of Mathematics
description: Global competition focusing on mental mathematics, rapid computation, missing digit addition, long division, metric unit conversion, and pattern recognition.

sampleQuestions.question: Find the missing digit A in the column addition: 45,A68 + 23,415 = 69,183.
sampleQuestions.explanation: Look at the Hundreds column: A + 4 = 11 → A = 7.
